svg.text: Extended Euclid preserves the ideal while shrinking remainders to the generator
Each remainder ri = axi + byi stays inside aℤ + bℤ until rk+1 = 0 proves rk generates the whole ideal.
• Exactness (1071ℤ + 462ℤ ⊆ 21ℤ): Row i = 4 hits r₄ = 0, so 21 | 1071 and 21 | 462.
Every remainder is an exact multiple of 21:
20 integers sit strictly inside (0, 21) — none reachable!
Case B (Coprime Saturation): a = 13, b = 8 ⇒ 13ℤ + 8ℤ = 1ℤ = ℤ (Gcd(13, 8) = { 1 })
Every integer n ∈ ℤ has a witness pair (x, y) shown below each tick: coprime inputs saturate the entire integer line (no gaps).
